Episode 247. Liberation War of Laprarosa (6)
‘This is… impossible…!’
He couldn't believe it.

A chill ran down his spine. He felt as if the blue blade of Sigmund was already touching his throat. Shimat had never felt such an intense pressure from anyone before, unable to comprehend his opponent.

Since reaching Genesis, he had never considered that there might be a level beyond it. In ancient times and even after awakening from his seal, Genesis was still regarded as the pinnacle of martial power.
Yet, Jin now clearly seemed to have reached a level beyond that.
It wasn't just a minor difference like the one between Shimat and the legendary warrior Blue Wind Emperor (청풍제) during their prime, it was a clear and p
rofound ‘gap’.
One that was insurmountable.
Such a distant sky, in human form, was now pointing a sword at him. Even though he was positioned above, due to the difference between the sky and ground, he felt as if he was looking up at him.
[Didn't I ask you, Shimart? Are you ready?]
Kiiik-!
Shimart reflexively flinched and swung Tetalon. The crimson wave of his Red Divine Sword plunged into the ground, and in the meantime, Pibil was adjusting its shield and regaining its position.
Red Sea, the sword Shimat gained in Genesis known for its destructive power, tore through the sky and plunged towards the earth with immense force.
[Well, it was a pointless question anyway. Punishment is inevitable.]
Blue thunderbolts split Shimat's red light, dispersing it left and right. Before the red wave energy could touch the ground, Jin lightly swung his sword, effortlessly deflecting the Red Sea.
Compared to the vast energy within the Red Sea, it was a minimal effort.
'Even the prime Blue Wind Emperor struggled to counter that attack, and now it's deflected so easily.'
No matter how strong a river's current, it splits when it meets a rock.

Every movement and moment of Jin's sword, now combined with the power of the Battle God fusion, contained such depth. Shimat, too, couldn't fathom the profound and vast world that existed within that single sword.
As the Red Sea was countered, Shimat experienced an intense illusion as if he was thrown naked into the universe of 'Battle Gods’.

He hadn’t even directly clashed swords yet, but he felt engulfed, struggling helplessly within. In his vision, a giant that couldn't be fully grasped with a mere glance was crushing him with just a gaze.
{Battle God Brother!}
It was a transmission from Limagas.
Caught up in the illusion, Shimat was making a fatal mistake. Losing focus with the enemy right in front of him.
Upon hearing Limagas's voice and returning to reality, Jin's blade was already flying towards his neck.
There was no escaping, no blocking it.

Had Shimat been fighting alone, it would have been a crushing final blow. Sensing Shimat's state, Limagas intuitively poured all the energy from the airborne fortress to form a protective shield around him.
“Kugh!”
The blue sword, tearing through the shield, with eyes unshaken by the immense backlash generated by the power of the four airborne fortresses.
That blade didn't stop. Shimart could only react after seeing Sigmund fully enter the shield.
Gritting his teeth, he swung Tetallon. With all his might, like in his days before he became a ruler, when he was just a lone challenger without a name or clan.
“Yaaaaah!”

The earth-shattering noise erupted as if a mountain split in half. The wave energy Shimat was standing on shattered like glass, and the scattered red wave energy reformed a space for him to regain his footing.

After about five layers of brainwaves formed and collapsed, Shimat was already drenched in sweat from before the strike. Jin looked down at him as he fell, his eyes seemingly emotionless, yet behind them raged a fiery wrath. The wrath of the divine being Ban, of the Plutonian, of Jin himself.
Even a moment's submission to that anger and it feels like his throat would be slit.
That's why Shimart concentrated only on his will. He immersed himself in the thought that he had to fight back.
If he didn't, he felt like he would run, and only think of fleeing.
If he fled even once, there wouldn't be a second chance. From then on, he would forever be on the run from Jin and the Plutonian, hiding somewhere.
That cowardly future might not even last long.
‘Doesn't this look like a fight between an adult and a child…?!’
‘Can a Battle God really fall so easily? Even the prime Wind Emperor said that defeating a Battle God required risking one's life!’

The battle defied the logic of the Red Plutonian. Precisely, it was overturning the understanding of all warriors in the world. There shouldn't be such a vast difference in a battle between two of the same Genesis level.
However, Murakan recognized the reason at a glance.

[Being of the same ‘Genesis’ seems to have been a poison to that Shimat. He almost got buried. In the past, our kids also had such an opponent when they saw Elona. Well, they weren’t 'Genesis' though.]
“So, the leader of those lesser beings got crushed under the supremacy of the Battle God union? Murakan.”

[That's right, Teto. While it’s true that there is a significant gap, Shimat has seen even things that others cannot see. The difference that only those with the insight of 'Genesis' can see. So he was on the verge of breaking down.]
"Well, in the past, many gods fell even before they fought with the battle gods."

[Still, it's certain that he came up from the bottom with tenacity. So, even if he wavered, he immediately pulled himself together like that. What a foolish guy, he should've evaluated whether he was on the right path after achieving so much. Why would he provoke and meet puny beings like you and the other Battle gods? If he had used his head a little, he could have been of great help to the world.]
Kwa-duk, Kru-duk-duk...!
Every time Jin pushed Shimart forward, thunder poured from the entire sky. The regular fleet was already scattering, unable to withstand the lightning.
The airborne fortress couldn't even reunite the fleet. They were busy protecting Shimat, and the continuous lightning was shattering the shields.

The once-solid red wave energy barriers and numerous shields were shattering like dry leaves underfoot. The crew of the regular fleets met their end without even a scream, and more of the Red Plutonian were falling inside the fortresses.

It was due to the shock. Even the first-class Battle Kings were foaming their mouths and falling from the shockwaves and thunder Jin created. The outer armor of the fortresses was being torn apart relentlessly.
[Well, let's do what we have to do.]
Murakan revealed his fangs and grinned.
He then directly exhaled towards Pibil. Pibil had to resist his breath with only its outer armor and the constantly operating shield.
All the power was focused on Shimat. If they diverted even a little to protect the main body of Pibil, Shimart would be in greater danger.
The moment Pibil's armor was destroyed again, the bridge opened, revealing Bekios. As soon as he came out, he used his fortress form to confront Murakan.
He resembled a giant lion with wings. Just as Bekios opened his mouth to spew a beam, Linpa's great sword pierced his wing.

It was Linpa who had been coughing up blood with every breath just moments ago. Bekios had clearly seen it, but now, Linpa was exuding even more powerful energy and her eyes shone brighter than before.
"Transformation,what...  changes?"
Then Linpa's great sword exploded, piercing a massive hole in Bekios' right wing. Lightning and blood fired from the airborne fortress filled the hole, but the other Battle Kings were not idle.

With the new beginning of the Battle God Union and resonance, the Battle Kings hearts were set ablaze again. Without any signs of exhaustion, they leaped and charged, wielding their brightly shining weapons.
"You, who dared to call yourself the ‘Plutonian’, cannot fully pay for your sin even with death!"

As soon as Bekios appeared, he had to endure the pain of both his wings and limbs being cut off. Although blood and red wave energy were immediately supplied for rapid recovery, the onslaught of the Battle Kings was much more intense.
Other great Battle Kings hurriedly exited the bridge as well. Bakarun and Rakiman also entered the Fortress Form and confronted the Battle Kings.
However, this had no influence on the overall situation.
Although the current Red Plutonian was undoubtedly at what could be called their peak strength, it was solely because their technological prowess was overwhelming.
The terrifying destructive and mobility powers of the aerial fortress and fleet.
Jin, having achieved Battle God fusion, made their technological prowess meaningless. It also prevented Shimat from asserting his dignity as a Genesisis Knight.
The Red Plutonian, with their technology and Shimat's power blocked.

From then on, they had no choice but to become a group with nothing to show for it when compared to other major powers. Excluding Shimat, the only transcendentally powerful beings were the remaining three great Battle Kings.
Naturally, they alone could never handle Murakan and the Battle Kings.
"It won't work, Battle Kings Brother! Retreat...!"
Shimat shouted.

In his view, it was a misjudgment for the great Battle Kings to have come out. He should have overcome his rapidly rising heart energy, seized some initiative from Jin, and then acted. Even at the cost of losing a fortress. That way, he could have laid the groundwork for calling Kri.
For Shimat, who couldn't immediately issue an order because he was dealing with Jin's sword, it was a painful situation.
[What are you worried about, Shimat?]
Swoosh-!
Sigmund struck down on Shimat's shoulder. Although it wasn't severed thanks to the fortress's red wave energy barrier, the wound was filled with the thunder energy of divine beings.
It felt as if his entire body was filled with fire and lightning rather than blood. Shimat, suppressing his trembling body in agony, lunged his sword towards Jin's face.
Jin was certain that Shimat's blade wouldn't penetrate deeply and didn't even dodge. As expected, Tetallon merely grazed Jin's cheek as it passed by.
Before the blood could trail down his cheek, and as it was oxidized by the heat of the lightning, Jin locked eyes with Shimat.
Then, he exploded with the energy of the radiant heart. To unleash a sword for judgment. A sword to prove that in this world, only one can wield the name of the Plutonian.
Plutonian Sword Battle God Technique, 10 Sword (명왕검 투신기 제10검)
Plutonian Domination Sword - Opening (명왕군림검 – 개)
[You shouldn't have messed with us.]
